description: Four pitch shifters on one panel, two moving a pitch by whole octaves and two by whole semitones

params.text: Shifts that section by a whole number of octaves, four down to four up across its travel, with five reached only at the very ends
Shifts that section by a whole number of semitones, six down to six up across its travel, with seven reached only at the very ends

inputs.text: The pitch that octave section shifts
The pitch that semitone section shifts
Shifts both octave sections by a whole number of octaves, one octave for every 2V, added to what their knobs set
Nothing in the module reads this jack: both octave sections take their octave CV from the other octave CV input, despite the panel giving this section one of its own
Shifts that semitone section by a whole number of semitones, one semitone for every 2V, added to what its knob sets

outputs.text: That octave section's input moved by its knob and its CV
That semitone section's input moved by its knob and its CV

notes: the knob and the CV are each rounded to a whole step before they are added, so an output only ever lands on an exact octave or semitone away from its input
